Payload:
The entropy switch is a feasible contingency, but \(10^{-3}\) is not a validated universal threshold. Enzo uses that value for its internal-energy pressure switch, with a separate synchronization threshold; CosmoMHD tested \(0.008\). [Enzo](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1307.2265), [CosmoMHD](https://arxiv.org/pdf/astro-ph/0611863)

For the smooth GLM+Janhunen equations, advecting \(S=\rho(p/\rho^\gamma)\) with zero entropy source is consistent. An entropy-based pressure reset must include \(q^2/2\) when rebuilding total energy and record the resulting energy correction explicitly.

Qualification needs smooth/source tests, cold MHD shock tests, correction ledgers, and threshold/resolution sensitivity. Shock heating must survive the switch. [PLUTO manual §2.2.4](https://plutocode.ph.unito.it/userguide.pdf)

This cannot remove residual-divergence forces or establish that the cold cells are physical. Finish the \(L=1\) control first.

Review saved in `observations/dual_energy_contingency_review.txt/json`. No implementation or model runs.
